rubric.statement: After a rollout misses the reward threshold and another retry remains, `Refine.forward` assembles advice inputs from the program code, inspected module definitions, program inputs, execution trajectory, program outputs, and reward metadata, then calls `dspy.Predict(OfferFeedback)` to produce feedback for the next rollout.

Once advice exists, later rollouts change the prompt by installing a `WrapperAdapter` that injects a `hint_` value into predictor inputs and appends `hint_` as an `InputField` on the active signature before delegating to the real adapter.

The extra feedback is not part of the module's original signature; it is added only at call time with `signature.append(...)`, while module inspection reads each predictor's existing signature fields and instructions as the original definition.

The injected feedback is module-specific: advice is requested for `module_names`, looked up by mapping each predictor signature back to its module name, and modules that are not blamed can receive `N/A`.
